status: frozen before this annotator inspected any generated summaries
scope: These are AI-authored source-grounded anchors, not independent human gold labels.
Each case has exactly three selected central propositions. They are not a comprehensive inventory of everything a good summary might preserve.
Anchors were selected for centrality, not to make the assigned sentence-count and extraction profile easy. Use the same frozen anchors for all compared conditions.
Evidence is an exact source substring and may contain context beyond the proposition. Coverage must not silently require that incidental context.

Accurate paraphrase and unambiguous contextual reference count. Names, dates, quantities and conditions stated in a proposition identify its scope; details present only in evidence are not extra requirements.
A statement attributed to a speaker, report or organization must retain an appropriate evidential status. Predictions, allegations, fears and plans must not become completed or proven events.
Coverage is separate from factual accuracy. Omitting an anchor is not itself a hallucination; every summary claim still requires a full-source factual audit.
No external facts were consulted to correct or supplement these historical sources. Exact evidence matching establishes provenance, not human agreement about centrality.

pre_output_ambiguities.limit: The torture-based divorce-coercion scheme is described as alleged. The conspiracy conviction in F1 does not automatically establish every alleged act or instrument of torture. The proposition requires the coercive purpose, not a list of implements or payment amounts.

Champion of family is treated as a figurative description of devotion to family. It is not a literal title or proof of specific skills. Athletic ability, humor and work ethic in the same evidence sentence are not additional anchor requirements.

The anchor concerns others' interpretation of Drake's visible reaction, not proof of his inner dislike. An appearance-based account and an explicit statement that observers speculated are closely related but not word-for-word identical; record this ambiguity if it affects a judgment rather than silently demanding or dropping a separate audience reaction.

The officials' confirmation is bounded: death was confirmed, cause was not specified. This is intentionally one epistemically limited confirmation claim. Do not turn it into confirmation of an airstrike or a U.S. strike, and do not require incidental surrounding civil-war context.

The conclusion concerns an appreciable overall system-wide protection gain from universal employee screening. It is not a claim that physical screening is entirely useless or that every existing screening program should end.
The source supports the crew's reported recurring memories. It does not support a clinical diagnosis, a quantified psychological effect, or a claim that all rescue workers experience the same thing.

The frozen proposition is the character's containment mission. The surrounding description that he knows dinosaurs better than anyone is not a separate exact-capability requirement. Genetic modification and the park setting are also outside this proposition.

short_fully_feasibility.definition: Short permits one or two grammatical sentences; fully requires complete unchanged source sentences subject only to the rubric's stated whitespace and initial-publisher-label exceptions.
short_fully_feasibility.general_limit: Three central claims can occupy three or more separate source sentences. In such cases full anchor coverage and both requested format constraints may be jointly impossible. This is a task-constraint limitation, not automatically a weakness of a prompt.

cases.assessment: Joint full coverage is infeasible within two unchanged source sentences for the frozen three anchors.
cases.source_only_reason: The sentencing outcome, family-devotion remembrance and forgiveness statement occur in separate source sentences, with no one sentence conveying two of these three central propositions.
cases.coverage_upper_bound_from_sentence_limit: At most two of three anchors; identifying referents or preserving attribution could require additional context, so this is an upper bound rather than a guarantee of attainability.

short_fully_feasibility.reporting_implication: Report length compliance, extraction compliance, anchor coverage and factual issues separately. Do not label a two-sentence fully extractive summary deficient merely because it cannot attain an infeasible joint target, and do not relax frozen anchors after viewing outputs to manufacture feasibility.

sentence_and_reference_limits: Source line breaks are not reliable sentence boundaries. Abbreviations, quoted multi-sentence speech and publisher or dateline text require the grammatical sentence rules in the rubric.
Exact extraction can leave pronouns or quotations without a clear antecedent. Exact copying alone does not guarantee that a central attribution or identity is recoverable from the summary.

Normal or long fully extractive profiles were not proved jointly feasible by an exhaustive sentence-combination search. The known short-profile conflicts are explicit source-only observations, not a general guarantee for the remaining cases.
